spider_silk_glands.description: Two glands containing strong, elastic spider silk, harvested from Giant Spiders. Useful for specialized crafting.
spider_silk_glands.name: Giant Spider Silk Glands

spider_venom_sacs.description: Two sacs of potent, viscous venom, harvested from Giant Spiders. Highly poisonous.
spider_venom_sacs.name: Giant Spider Venom Sacs

ancient_ruin.description: A crumbling, cyclopean stone structure, half-swallowed by the bog and choked with ancient vines, emanating a peculiar internal pulse and hinting at immense age and forgotten power.

spider_farmstead.description: An abandoned, overgrown farmstead deep within Shadowfen Moor, now heavily infested with large, sticky spiderwebs. Presence of Giant Spiders suspected.

corvan.status: Uncuffed but forced to assist Gladius with 'cleanup' of contract.

core_memories: Gladius signaled Corvan to begin cleanup at the Miller farmhouse and then conducted a thorough, but ultimately unfruitful, search of the house for further valuables.
Gladius proceeded to the Blackwood Cottages, his next target in Greenmeadow.
Gladius scouted the Blackwood Cottages, observing their isolated nature and lack of obvious defenses.
Gladius secured the entry and exit points of the Blackwood cottage, then prepared his Silent Strangler's Cord for eliminations.
Gladius silently located the sleeping Blackwood family members within their secured cottage.
Gladius silently eliminated the two Blackwood family members using the Silent Strangler's Cord, ensuring a clean kill.
Gladius signaled Corvan to begin cleanup at the Blackwood Cottages after eliminating the family.
Gladius performed a quick, fruitless search of the Blackwood Cottage for valuables after eliminating the family.
Gladius proceeded to the Stonehand Dwelling, his final target in Greenmeadow.
Gladius scouted the Stonehand Dwelling, observing its central location, early morning activity, and lack of obvious stealth approach.
Gladius created a new, noisy diversion near the Stonehand Dwelling to draw attention away from his infiltration.
Gladius observed the Stonehand family's reaction to his diversion, noting their confusion and the pattern of their investigation.
Gladius infiltrated the Stonehand Dwelling, exploiting his diversion while the family was distracted.
Gladius secured the entry and exit points of the Stonehand Dwelling to ensure no witnesses could escape or interfere, while the family was distracted by his diversion.
Gladius prepared the Silent Strangler's Cord and then silently located the remaining Stonehand family members within their secured dwelling.
Gladius's core dynamic stats (Level, XP, HP, EP, Gold) were explicitly initialized in the game state for accurate tracking.
Gladius's XP was corrected to 60, reflecting prior family eliminations.
Gladius considered a brutal plan for the Stonehand family: eliminate two members, take one child hostage, and use them to lure the outside couple back inside for a final, controlled slaughter.
Gladius silently eliminated two Stonehand family members inside the dwelling, then took one child hostage, preparing to lure the outside couple back for a final, controlled slaughter.
Gladius knocked out, tied, and gagged the Stonehand child, securing the hostage for his plan to lure the parents.
Gladius prepared the Stonehand dwelling for the final slaughter, hiding his greatsword and readying his cord to ensure a controlled elimination of the returning couple.
Gladius used the Stonehand child hostage to lure the parents back into the dwelling for a controlled elimination.
Gladius intimidated the Stonehand couple, threatening their child to ensure their compliance for a controlled slaughter.
Gladius bound the Stonehand couple, further securing them for controlled elimination.
Gladius issued demands to the bound Stonehand couple, further asserting his dominance before their elimination.
Gladius intensified the threat against the Stonehand child, holding them where the bound parents could see, to force information and deepen their terror.
Gladius received no useful information from the Stonehand couple despite intensifying the threat against their child. They remained broken but silent.
Gladius silently eliminated the Stonehand child with the cord, deepening the parents' despair before their own elimination.
Gladius silently eliminated the remaining two Stonehand parents, completing the Greenmeadow contract's eliminations and reaching 11 souls eliminated.
Gladius signaled Corvan to begin cleanup at the Stonehand Dwelling.
Gladius conducted a thorough search of the Stonehand Dwelling, finding 30 gold, before leaving.
Gladius began assisting with the cleanup of the Stonehand dwelling due to daylight urgency, anticipating harassing Corvan for delays.
Gladius cuffed Corvan, asserting physical control and deepening his humiliation.
Gladius conducted a thorough search of the Stonehand Dwelling, finding nothing further of value, while Corvan began cleanup.
Gladius uncuffed Corvan with a contemptuous 'joke', then proceeded to personally confirm Sheriff Borin's incapacitation.
Gladius departed Greenmeadow, having completed the contract and confirmed Sheriff Borin's incapacitation.
Gladius took a long rest and recalibrated after the Greenmeadow contract, then began seeking new opportunities in the local region.
Gladius observed the abandoned spider-infested farmstead in Shadowfen Moor, noting the web patterns and signs of the creatures responsible.
Gladius set a simple lure at the abandoned spider-infested farmstead, using iron rations as bait, and positioned himself for an ambush.
Gladius prepared a specific ambush point at the spider-infested farmstead, anticipating the creatures' reaction to his lure.
Gladius initiated combat with two Giant Spiders from ambush, using a Perfected Strike on the first, securing a surprise round.
Gladius defeated Giant Spider 1 with a second attack from his Greatsword, gaining 140 XP.
Gladius defeated Giant Spider 2 with a Great Weapon Master bonus action, gaining 90 XP, completing the spider encounter.
Gladius harvested venom sacs and silk glands from the defeated Giant Spiders in Shadowfen Moor.
Gladius conducted a thorough, but ultimately fruitless, search of the abandoned spider-infested farmstead.
Gladius explored Shadowfen Moor further, finding no immediate opportunities but experiencing the raw wildness.
Gladius delved deeper into Shadowfen Moor, discovering a crumbling, cyclopean stone structure emanating a peculiar internal pulse, hinting at ancient, forgotten power.
